# Included Schedule Changes, Setpoint Changes and Graphics Edits — Building Automation Service Plans Desk Table

The desk table below gives, for each tier of the Building Automation Service Plans, the occupancy schedule changes carried out per month at no charge, the fee per schedule change beyond them, the setpoint changes carried out per month at no charge, the graphics page edits included per plan year and the fee per graphics page edit beyond them.

| Tier | Schedule changes included per month | Fee per further schedule change (USD) | Setpoint changes included per month | Graphics edits included per plan year | Fee per further graphics edit (USD) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Controls Help Desk Subscription | 1 | 95 | 2 | 0 | 275 |
| Alarm Monitoring Plan | 2 | 85 | 4 | 2 | 250 |
| Scheduled Controls Service Plan | 4 | 75 | 8 | 4 | 225 |
| Software Assurance & Upgrade Plan | 6 | 65 | 12 | 8 | 200 |
| Remote Optimization Plan | 12 | 55 | 24 | 16 | 175 |
| Integrated Building Automation Partnership | 40 | 0 | 80 | 48 | 150 |

Reading notes:

- Schedule and setpoint allowances are monthly counts; the graphics edit allowance is a plan-year count.
- The Integrated Building Automation Partnership carries a schedule change fee of 0 USD, so a schedule change beyond its 40 included changes a month costs nothing.
- Hypothetical reading: an Alarm Monitoring Plan site that has already had its 2 included schedule changes in a month carries 85 USD for each further schedule change that month; a Controls Help Desk Subscription site has no included graphics edits, so its first graphics edit of the plan year carries the 275 USD fee.
